description: Mods for Claude Code, published from Sanduhr.
name: sanduhr-mods

plugins.description: A live now-playing line above the prompt: artist, title and a moving progress bar. On Windows from the media session (YouTube Music in Chrome included); on a Mac from every player through Sanduhr's adapter, or Music and Spotify without it.
plugins.name: now-playing

plugins.description: When a turn creates a tag (git tag, gh release create), a Claude sprite runs across the band above the prompt and crosses a checkered finish line, and the tag's name lands beside it. /finish-line [tag] replays it. Reads nothing, writes nothing, no network.
plugins.name: finish-line

plugins.description: A band above the prompt showing every message to another agent that is still waiting on a reply.
plugins.name: agent-comms

plugins.description: Pushes the dashboard decision log hard: a standing instruction, a nudge after commits and edit-heavy turns, and a running count.
plugins.name: decision-logger

plugins.description: /page <project> opens a side pane with that project's 626labs.dev portfolio card: summary, banner and link.
plugins.name: page-pane
